adaptation.source_axes: source -Y maps to paper +X, source +X to paper +Y, source +Z remains up
adaptation.fin_curves: mean left/right world dihedral per stage; local roll is the difference between adjacent stages
adaptation.symmetry: bilaterally mirrored geometry and averaged fin motion; native small left/right asymmetry is not copied
adaptation.loop_closure: remove endpoint drift, fit a periodic cubic curve, then bake ordinary local transforms with a closed cyclic tangent
adaptation.scope: Swim is the only native action; idle, faster swim, surge and KO are authored adaptations
